services_heading: Complete Gas and Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From routine boiler servicing to emergency repairs and full system installations, we handle every heating need.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Heating failed? We diagnose and repair boiler faults the same day. No call-out charge — you pay only for parts and labour.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Safety Checks
services.desc: Annual boiler maintenance keeps your system safe and efficient. We issue your safety certificate and catch small problems before they cost big money.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: New boiler? We'll survey your system, recommend the right model, and install it with a full warranty. Expect lower energy bills and reliable heat.

services.title: Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Ageing radiators or poor circulation? We upgrade your heating system to modern, efficient standards — cuts fuel costs and improves comfort.

services.title: Gas Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Smell gas? We find leaks fast using specialist equipment and repair them safely. Your safety is our priority.

services.title: Landlord Safety Inspections
services.desc: Comply with the Gas Safety Regulations. We conduct thorough annual inspections and provide the certificate your tenants need.

about_pullquote: I started this job because I hate cowboys charging folks three times the odds.
about_para_1: BlueStream Maintenance has been keeping Wolverhampton homes warm and safe for over 15 years. We're a small, local outfit — just me and my team — and we've built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing things properly, and charging a fair price. Every engineer is Gas Safe registered and fully trained in the latest heating systems.
about_para_2: We're not the biggest heating firm in the Midlands, but we're the one your neighbours actually call back. Customers choose us because we listen, we explain what's wrong without the jargon, and we don't oversell. Whether it's an emergency callout at midnight or a planned boiler installation, we treat your home like it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a Sunday evening — called BlueStream and they were at the door by 8pm. Fixed it in under two hours. Professional, friendly, and the price was honest. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had my annual service done last month. The engineer explained everything as he went, showed me what needs watching, and didn't try to sell me anything I didn't need. That's rare. Very pleased.
reviews.author: Margaret P.

reviews.text: New boiler installed by BlueStream in October. They did a proper survey first, answered all my questions, and the install was clean and quick. Heating bills already noticeably lower. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: James C.
